gloss: medical history; past illness; pre-existing condition

definitions.gloss: medical history; previous illness; pre-existing condition
definitions.explanation: illnesses, conditions, or medical events a person has had in the past

examples.japanese: {既往症|きおうしょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{問診票|もんしんひょう}に{既往症|きおうしょう}を{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: Fill in your medical history on the questionnaire.

examples.japanese: {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}の{既往症|きおうしょう}があるので{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: I need to be careful because I have a history of diabetes.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{既往症|きおうしょう} is important medical information doctors need to know.

SYNONYMS:
- {既往歴|きおうれき} - medical history
- {病歴|びょうれき} - medical record/history

WHEN ASKED:
- {初診|しょしん} - first visit to a clinic
- {入院|にゅういん}{時|じ} - hospital admission
- {保険|ほけん}{加入時|かにゅうじ} - insurance enrollment

COMMON QUESTIONS:
- {既往症|きおうしょう}はありますか - Do you have any pre-existing conditions?
- {過去|かこ}に{大|おお}きな{病気|びょうき}をしたことがありますか - Have you had any major illnesses?

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既往症|きおうしょう}がある - have medical history
- {既往症|きおうしょう}を{申告|しんこく}する - report medical history
- {既往症|きおうしょう}なし - no pre-existing conditions
